source: UCI Machine Learning Repository — Student Performance
description: Student performance in secondary education of two Portuguese schools. Includes demographic, social/emotional, and academic features. Target: G3 (final grade 0–20).
feature_engineering: g1_to_g2_change — grade change from first to second period
g1_to_g3_change — grade change from first to final period
avg_grade — average of G1, G2, G3
has_failed — binary: has at least one past class failure
studytime_effort — study time per grade point (inverse)

column_descriptions.school: student's school (GP - Gabriel Pereira or MS - Mousinho da Silveira)
column_descriptions.address: student's home address type (U - urban or R - rural)
column_descriptions.pstatus: parent's cohabitation status (T - living together or A - apart)
column_descriptions.mjob: mother's job (teacher, health, services, at_home, other)
column_descriptions.reason: reason to choose this school (home, reputation, course, other)
column_descriptions.paid: extra paid classes within course subject (yes/no)
column_descriptions.famrel: quality of family relationships (1=very bad to 5=excellent)
column_descriptions.freetime: free time after school (1=very low to 5=very high)
column_descriptions.goout: going out with friends (1=very low to 5=very high)
column_descriptions.dalc: workday alcohol consumption (1=very low to 5=very high)
column_descriptions.walc: weekend alcohol consumption (1=very low to 5=very high)
column_descriptions.health: current health status (1=very bad to 5=very good)
column_descriptions.subject: subject (Math or Portuguese)
